title: Juniper releases security updates for junos OS
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-314.050420: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – JUNIPER RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES FOR JUNOS OS
leadParagraph: Juniper has released security updates to address a vulnerability affecting multiple versions of Junos operating systems. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Juniper has released security updates to address a vulnerability affecting multiple versions of Junos operating systems. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to take control of an affected system.

TTCSIRT encourages users and administrators to review Juniper Security Advisory JSA 11021 and apply the necessary updates:

https://kb.juniper.net/InfoCenter/index?page=content&id=JSA11021
